nodes.label: Godot MCP Server
nodes.author: Coding-Solo
nodes.rationale: Gives AI agents a direct feedback loop with real Godot projects (launch, run, capture output, control execution) so they learn what works and what does not, improving code generation and debugging assistance.

nodes.label: createErrorResponse helper
nodes.rationale: Errors return a message plus a list of possible solutions, supporting graceful error handling with actionable guidance.

nodes.label: GODOT_PATH environment variable
nodes.rationale: Overrides automatic Godot executable detection; primary fix for 'Godot Not Found'.

nodes.label: Code Style Guidelines
nodes.rationale: TypeScript for type safety, JSDoc on all functions/classes, meaningful interfaces, and graceful error handling with detailed messages.

nodes.label: Cross-Platform Compatibility
nodes.rationale: Use Node.js path utilities and env-var configuration, consider varied Godot install locations, so the server works across operating systems.

nodes.label: Agent Feedback Loop
nodes.rationale: Direct feedback from running real Godot projects lets agents see what works and what doesn't.

nodes.label: Godot MCP Architecture
nodes.rationale: Two-tier design: simple operations use Godot CLI directly; complex ones go through one bundled GDScript that takes operation type and JSON params, avoiding generating temporary files per operation.

nodes.label: godot_operations.gd bundled operations script
nodes.rationale: Single comprehensive GDScript accepting operation type and JSON parameters enables flexible dynamic execution without per-operation temp files.
